Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.

• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.

• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.

• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.

• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.

• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

🧩 Patches: The Ultimate Rectangle Logic Puzzle - inspired by Shikaku

6×6 · 10×10 · 12×12 · 20×20 · 30×30 and 5 different shapes!

Dive into Patches, the addictive logic puzzle based on Shikaku, the classic Japanese grid-dividing game - also known as Rectangles or Divide by Box. If you love Shikaku puzzles and want to put your spatial reasoning to the test, Patches is the perfect rectangle logic puzzle for you!

Your goal: Partition the grid into rectangles and squares so that each shape contains exactly one numbered clue matching its area. The unique twist: Each clue also tells you the shape direction: Square, wide, tall, free, or any!

🧩 How to Play Patches:

1. Every cell contains a shape icon and a number. The number indicates how many cells your rectangle must span.

2. Draw rectangles by dragging across the grid. A valid selection appears in orange; an invalid one turns red. To undo a rectangle, simply tap it.

3. Your goal is to tile the entire grid so that every cell belongs to exactly one rectangle. No empty cells, no overlapping.

The Five Shape Types:

Each clue's icon tells you how your rectangle must be shaped:

◾ Square: Equal width and height.

◾ Wide: Width exceeds height.

◾ Tall: Height exceeds width.

◾ Free: Any proportion, but the cell count is fixed.

◾ Any: No restrictions whatsoever.

These five constraints are what give every puzzle its distinct challenge.

🔦 Features:

🧠 Daily Challenges: A fresh Patches logic puzzle every day – keep your streak alive!

📏 Multiple Board Sizes: From compact 6×6 grids to massive 20×20 boards – plus 10×10, 12×12 and more. Choose the rectangle puzzle size that matches your skill level!

⭐ Conquer the daily leaderboard by getting the fastest solving time.
